prompt: Create an original 150 second Celtic acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: fiddle, tin whistle, bodhran, harp. Style: lilting compound-meter dance and modal melody. Tempo approximately 104 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A lively and elegant classical-style piece featuring a prominent string ensemble and harpsichord. The music has a dance-like, jig feel, with a clear melody and driving rhythm.
description.zh: 一首活泼优雅的古典风格乐曲，以突出的弦乐合奏和大键琴为特色。音乐带有舞曲般的吉格舞曲感，旋律清晰，节奏感强。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
